headline: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) vs. Medtronic (MDT): Which MedTech Stock Looks Better Positioned for Growth?
summary: Intuitive Surgical (NASDAQ:ISRG) beat both top- and bottom-line consensus estimates in its fiscal Q2 2026 results, with revenue for the quarter growing 19% to $2.89 billion and adjusted EPS reaching $2.80, exceeding expectations by $0.30. However, the stock declined as investors focused on concerns surrounding slowing domestic procedure growth. Medtronic (NYSE:MDT), meanwhile, continued its turnaround […]

headline: Is Medtronic’s Cannula Recall and CoreMap Investment Altering The Investment Case For Medtronic (MDT)?
summary: In late July 2026, Medtronic voluntarily initiated a Class II recall of specific lots of its DLP One-Piece Pediatric Arterial Cannula after two complaints revealed loose foreign material with trace blood, affecting worldwide distribution including several U.S. states.
